    Research

    Overview

    My research focuses on modeling physically plausible human behavior in 3D environments. I am interested in combining learning-based methods with geometric constraints to enable realistic interaction between humans, objects, and scenes.

    Current Directions

    • Scene-aware human motion generation with contact and grasping
    • Human-object interaction with co-speech gestures
    • Curvature- and appearance-preserving mesh simplification
    • Geometry-aware learning for AR/VR and embodied AI
